title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat — Episode7 Trust Me

meta.Event Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What's wrong, An? You've never pulled me outside like this before a show...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You look waaay more nervous than usual!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even though we spent so much time practicing, I'm still worried about whether or not I can actually sing while we're on stage...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know. I get why you feel that way too. This is where you made your big mistake after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I even promised to start relying on you more if I really needed help after that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sorry that I'm like this... I wish I knew how to have more confidence...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, wow! Your cheeks are so soft and squishy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An! Fwhy are youw pulling my heeks like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry! Now it's your turn. Come on, hit me with your best shot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I let you down. I wasn't there for you that time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was obsessed with protecting you and became blind to everything else around me. It was my fault too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why I'm probably just as nervous as you are now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I usually never feel this way, but today's different. I'm really worried and really excited at the same time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I want you to pull on my cheeks too, okay? Get me to relax somehow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly, genuinely believe that you have an absolutely amazing voice, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time I hear you sing, you make my heart dance and I can't help but want to sing with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly, genuinely, 100% feel that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're still worried about what's gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just listen to what I'm about to say.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's believe in what An Shiraishi has to say, the girl who absolutely loves the way you, Kohane Azusawa, sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I understand how it's hard for you to believe in yourself, but it's easy for you to believe what I'm saying, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I, An Shiraishi, will always believe in your ability to sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Did I ham it up a little too much...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I didn't think that for a second...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'll believe in you, An!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two actually ready for this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm ready!
I can do this!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Well, look what the cat dragged in. I never thought I'd see you again in my live house.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: We sang together that night, right? We're like war buddies. What's wrong with me coming to visit?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Haha. I appreciate it. Hey, if you're free, why don't you stick around and check out this event...?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
What event?
Oh, STAY GOLDEN. That takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Yeah, we even got EVER here.
Also, some other newer teams that have been making some noise lately.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Next up, we got our revenge act!
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I may not be at the same level as everyone else and don't know how to have more confidence in myself yet...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An said she likes the way I sing. She said that she really believes in me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So I can do it... I can sing!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright! Time to knock them off their socks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they won't know what hit 'em!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay. I think we're all set.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Nice! We're off to a good start!
We're totally in sync too!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We really got the crowd's attention with that last part. Next is Akito and Shiraishi's part.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, don't kick it into gear just yet. Wait until the chorus and explode...)
